fields.System.Title: FDN-805 — Prune delivered events
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a developer, I want delivered events removed after a retention window, so that the
"unsent events" query does not get slower every single day.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given events delivered longer ago than the retention window, when the prune job runs,
  • then they are deleted.
  • - Given undelivered or dead events, then they are never pruned regardless of age.
  • - Given the prune job, then it deletes in batches so it never holds a long lock.
  • - Given the outbox table, then an index on (status, created_at) supports the delivery
  • query.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | platform |
| Tables | outbox |
| Risks | Unpruned outbox slows delivery indefinitely ([doc 04 §3.1](../../../docs/04-modules.md)); unbatched delete locking the table ([doc 09 §11.2](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | integration |
